info.title: API-DocTest-Delete Ecommerce Cart Remove-v4-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Removal API allows businesses to efficiently manage the shopping cart experience by removing items from a user's cart. This operation is essential for maintaining an accurate representation of selected products and helping users manage their purchases. Typical consumers of this API include developers of ecommerce platforms and mobile applications that facilitate online shopping experiences. By enabling real-time updates to the cart, this API enhances user satisfaction and streamlines the checkout process.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the shopping cart.
delete.description: This operation allows you to remove a specified item from the user's shopping cart. Ensure that the item exists in the cart before attempting to remove it. This action updates the cart accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details of the item to be removed from the cart. It should contain the necessary identifiers to locate the item within the user's cart.

200.description: The item was successfully removed from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveRequest.description: A string representing the request body for removing an item from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.title: Cart Removal Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cart removal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the cart removal operation.

resultId.description: The identifier for the operation result.

state.description: The current state of the cart after removal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the removal request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the removal operation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the cart removal operation.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_200.description: Response object for the cart removal operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the operation record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the operation record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Details regarding the audit of an operation.
